Ōita Prefecture.question: Hita's _____: A festival held in Hita City in July with parade floats that are up to 12 meters high
Ōita Prefecture.fact: Hita's Gion Festival: A festival held in Hita City in July with parade floats that are up to 12 meters high. Although the festival only takes place once a year, the magnificent floats are on display year-round at the Gion Festival Float Museum in Kuma Town, Hita City.
